title: alyssum wulfenianum subsp. diffusum
intro: Alyssum wulfenianum subsp. diffusum, commonly known as Rock Alyssum, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Brassicaceae. It is known for its health benefits, particularly in reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality due to its sedative and calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Rock Alyssum include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, reducing muscle spasms and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its full range of bioactive compounds and health benefits.
